title: How to Customize Your Resume for Each Position QUICKLY to Land More Interviews
description:
Should you customize your resume? We believe the answer to that question is a resounding YES! But… we also fully recognize that it takes a TON of time to tailor every resume. Well, we’ve got you covered. With the latest version of the Teal Resume Builder, you can write a comprehensive career history and use that to very quickly pick and choose what to include on each custom resume. Gone are the days of using a bunch of resume templates and saving 15 versions of each. You can now log all of your career achievements in one place and use that to build and customize any resume you’ll ever need. 

To learn more, head to https://www.tealhq.com/tools/resume-builder.
